description: addDays rewritten with local-time milliseconds arithmetic, against the SPEC.md day arithmetic rule.

pr.title: Simplify addDays
pr.body: Replace the `Date.UTC` dance with a plain local date plus `n * 86400000` ms. Shorter and easier to read. Existing tests pass on my machine.

expected.description: addDays uses ms ± 86400000 on a local-time Date. SPEC.md says day arithmetic is calendar arithmetic on the key via Date.UTC, never ms ± 86400000 on local time. Across a daylight-saving change (a 23 or 25 hour day) the result skips or repeats a day, which breaks streaks and the 28-day history; it also depends on the machine's time zone.
